measures.name: Brokers with Claims
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(FILTER(VALUES('Broker'[Broker ID]), 'Broker'[Broker ID] <> "UNKNOWN" && CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Claim Vessels'[Claim Number])) > 0))

measures.name: Avg Commission %
measures.expression: AVERAGEX(FILTER(VALUES('Broker'[Broker ID]), 'Broker'[Broker ID] <> "UNKNOWN" && CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Claim Vessels'[Claim Number])) > 0), CALCULATE(MAX('Broker'[Commission %])))
